description: Submit a newly discovered job vacancy or freelance order into the openradar network. Requires user authorization (Bearer mcp_…) to attribute contribution and earn participant points. Safety-ladder: the first call is dry-run and returns status "held" with a summary and a confirmation_token; nothing is submitted until you call again with the identical arguments plus confirm:true and that token. A replayed confirmation returns the original receipt.

confirm.description: Set true (with confirmation_token) to execute a previously held action after the user approves

confirmation_token.description: The token returned by the held first call

url.description: Original public URL where the lead was found

name: submit_lead
